items.title: Artie Shaw — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I’ll tell you who else I worked with every once in a while: Paul Specht would get a band together

ctx.x: But he was marvelous, and whenever he would play, Red would . . . He’d make Red sound silly. He played in a sort of . . . Oh, and I’ll tell you who else I worked with every once in a while: Paul Specht would get a band together, and there would be Sterling Bose, and Bob Chester on tenor, and Charlie Spivak on trumpet. Some good musicians around. But a lot of them couldn’t play studios. Bob Chester never made it to studios.
